name: Heidar
description: Leader of the Cult of Rimewind.

description_citations.text: "The Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar visits and convinces Haakon to ally.
timeline.quote: Heidar convinced him to ally.

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Thaw proceeds, Gendrin orders spells that temporarily halt it on Heidar's advice, plunging the continent back into winter.
timeline.quote: Gendrin , the leader of the cult, ordered the casting of spells that temporarily halted the Thaw

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "Battling the Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar finds Phyrexian etchings in the keep's depths and goes mad; he murders Gendrin and takes command.
timeline.quote: in a fit of pique, Heidar murdered his master and assumed command of Rimewind

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The Rise of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
timeline.quote: Heidar allied with the undead Order of Stromgald and their leader Haakon

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The Rise of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cult reanimates Phyrexian war-beasts; when Lovisa Coldeyes' Balduvians storm Rimewind, Heidar activates them, causing a massacre and rampage.
timeline.quote: Heidar activated the Phyrexians , turning the battle into a massacre

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "Phyrexian Awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garza Zol's assassins kill the mad Heidar.
timeline.quote: they managed to kill the mad wizard

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The End of Rimewind". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dagsson recounts watching Phyrexian machines swallow Soldev and reveals Heidar's plan to awaken more from the glacier, and the guide realizes who he is.
timeline.quote: And now a madman, Heidar of Rimewind , wants to build an army of these constructs.

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The master machinist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ysidra shows Vannemir a vision of Heidar and the Thaw.
timeline.quote: He seeks to keep the world encased in ice until the end of time

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir sees orc warlords and Heidar's army destroying settlement after settlement across Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Settlement after settlement was extirpated from the face of Terisiare

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir sees the future in which Darien is killed at the battle for Kjeld.
timeline.quote: a lethal arc of cryomantic energy blasted him off of his horse and hurled him into a wall

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir sees Heidar made ruler of Terisiare and the land plunged into endless winter.
timeline.quote: Then he saw Heidar lifted up as ruler of Terisiare and all bowed to his terrible power

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arcum devotes his life to atonement, helps stop the Ice Phyrexians, warns Kjeldor, and dies of a heart attack.
timeline.quote: He died of a heart attack not long after.

citation.text: "Arcum Dagsson", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar arrives with Phyrexian war machines reclaimed from the melting ice.
timeline.quote: Heidar , the Rimewind Cult leader, shows up armed with Phyrexian war machines reclaimed from the melting ice.

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar attacks allies and enemies alike, giving Garza Zol reason to have him assassinated, then retreats to Krov.
timeline.quote: In desperation, Heidar started attacking both enemies and allies

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arguing about stopping the Thaw, Heidar accidentally kills Gendrin and takes over as Master of Rimewind.
timeline.quote: Heidar accidentally killed the old man.

citation.text: "Heidar", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Allied with Haakon, Heidar's scholars find the incantations to awaken the Phyrexians at Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Heidar's scholars found the incantations needed to awaken the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Heidar", section "Alliance with Stromgald". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar allies with Garza Zol for Krovikan elementalists and helps her crush the Balduvian-Kjeldoran-Yavimayan alliance.
timeline.quote: He allied with Garza Zol , the powerful vampire queen of the plague-wracked city of Krov

citation.text: "Heidar", section "Alliance with Krov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar activates the Phyrexians against a Balduvian force and executes Lovisa Coldeyes.
timeline.quote: Lovisa was executed by Heidar.

citation.text: "Heidar", section "Revival of the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Driven mad, Heidar kills Lindra; Garza Zol has assassins kill him.
timeline.quote: ordered assassins planted in Rimewind to kill the mad wizard

citation.text: "Heidar", section "The end of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garza Zol orders the assassination of Heidar after he turns on Krov.
timeline.quote: Garza Zol ordered his assassination

citation.text: "Krov", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar convinces a hesitant Haakon to ally with the Rimewind.
timeline.quote: Although Haakon was initially hesitant, Heidar convinced him to ally.

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar awakens frozen Phyrexian war-beasts to stop Freyalise's Thaw; Arcum Dagsson goes to destroy his army.
timeline.quote: until the mad wizard Heidar awakened them in the hope he could stop Freyalise 's Thaw .

citation.text: "Ronom Glacier", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rimewind fails to undo the Thaw; New Argive secures control and the Order of Stromgald is defeated.
timeline.quote: tried to halt and undo the Thaw with their ice magic but ultimately failed

citation.text: "The Thaw", section "The Flood Ages (2934 to 3000 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir is given a mission to rescue a prisoner from Guldark and prevent Heidar's tyranny.
timeline.quote: to rescue a prisoner from the Torgash warlord Guldark

citation.text: "Vannemir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir frees Pik's sister and an elven girl, setting Terisiare on the path to victory.
timeline.quote: Vannemir fulfilled his mission

citation.text: "Vannemir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heidar tries to stop the spell's effect and re-cover the world in ice.
timeline.quote: Heidar tried to stop the effect of that spell and to cover the entire world with ice again.

citation.text: "World Spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannemir is shown a future in which Heidar's undead army, led by the Knights of Stromgald, destroys villages and towns.
timeline.quote: Heidar’s army, led by the Knights of Stromgald and composed of undead soldiers revived by necromancers, rampaged across the land

citation.text: "Ysidra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the vision Kjeld falls, King Darien dies and Heidar rules Terisiare in perpetual winter.
timeline.quote: leading to the fall of the city of Kjeld and the death of King Darien

citation.text: "Ysidra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Sent spies and assassins against him.
relations.quote: the vampire queen had sent spies and assassins against her former co-conspirator

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Garza Zol, now aware of the danger posed by Heidar and his machines, ordered assassins planted in Rimewind

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The End of Rimewind". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Krov", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: He was opposed by the famed master machinist Arcum Dagsson

citation.text: "Ronom Glacier", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Dagsson goes to stop Heidar's plan.
relations.quote: now I must go to stop Heidar.

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The master machinist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: to fulfill his destiny and save his world from being destroyed by

citation.text: "Vannemir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
